input: Join /data/orders.csv and /data/products.csv on product_id. For each category, compute the total revenue (quantity * price). Print 'category: total_revenue' sorted by revenue descending.

tool_calls: cat /data/orders.csv | head -n 20; echo "---"; cat /data/products.csv | head -n 20; echo "---"; ls -l /data/

tool_outputs.commands: cat /data/orders.csv | head -n 20; echo "---"; cat /data/products.csv | head -n 20; echo "---"; ls -l /data/
